aggregation_policy: Graph corpus nodes are chapter/section buckets; the wiki keeps atom-level text. V010 intentionally does not render one graph node per wiki atom.

rows.count_policy: One wiki count unit equals one public PASS atom reader row.
rows.compare_policy: Do not compare one-to-one against graph bucket nodes.

rows.count_policy: One graph count unit may aggregate multiple wiki atoms.
rows.compare_policy: Compare by aggregation coverage, not equal raw counts.

rows.unit: wiki atoms covered by corpus buckets
rows.source_field: wiki atoms after chapter/section bucket aggregation
rows.count_policy: Aggregated atom count should equal wiki_atom_total when no public atom is omitted by boundary.
rows.compare_policy: This is the reconciliation count that may be compared to wiki_atom_total.

count_scope_reconciliation.copy_check: wiki_atom_total counts atom reader rows; graph_corpus_node_total counts aggregate graph buckets; aggregated_atom_count is the only cross-scope coverage count.
count_scope_reconciliation.scope_mismatch_blocker: A raw wiki atom count and raw graph bucket count may differ without failing when aggregation_policy and aggregated_atom_count are visible.

count_scope_copy_check: Counts are complete only when the UI names all three scopes: wiki atom rows, graph corpus bucket nodes, and aggregated atom coverage.
nonclaim_boundary: Corpus reconciliation proves UI/index coverage, not scientific proof.
